list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, server_id AS __value FROM config.config_monitored_servers WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY name
list.description: Monitored SQL Server instance, from Darling's fleet registry.

list.name: clerk_type
list.label: Memory clerk
list.query:
SELECT mc.clerk_type
FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
  AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY mc.clerk_type
ORDER BY SUM(mc.memory_mb) DESC
list.definition:
SELECT mc.clerk_type
FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
  AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY mc.clerk_type
ORDER BY SUM(mc.memory_mb) DESC

list.description: Counters in the selected pack that were collected over the window. All plots the 12 busiest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sqlserver_cpu_utilization + COALESCE(other_process_cpu_utilization, 0) AS v
FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN max_workers_count > 0
    THEN total_current_workers_count::double precision / max_workers_count * 100.0
    ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM collect.v_cpu_scheduler_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT total_runnable_tasks_count AS v
FROM collect.v_cpu_scheduler_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT buffer_pool_mb AS v
FROM collect.v_memory_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT total_sessions AS v
FROM collect.v_session_summary_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(system_memory_state, ''), 'N/A') AS v
FROM collect.v_memory_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    cpu.sample_time
        - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
          * ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                MAX(cpu.sample_time) OVER (PARTITION BY cpu.server_id, cpu.collection_time)
                - cpu.collection_time
            )) / 900.0)::double precision AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    s.value
FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats AS cpu
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('SQL Server', cpu.sqlserver_cpu_utilization),
    ('Other', COALESCE(cpu.other_process_cpu_utilization, 0))
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(cpu.collection_time)
  AND cpu.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    cs.collection_time AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    s.value
FROM collect.v_cpu_scheduler_stats AS cs
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('Runnable Tasks', cs.total_runnable_tasks_count),
    ('Blocked Tasks', cs.total_blocked_task_count),
    ('Queued Requests', cs.total_queued_request_count)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(cs.collection_time)
  AND cs.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

WITH snapshot AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (cs.server_id)
        cs.*,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        CASE
            WHEN cs.max_workers_count > 0
            THEN cs.total_current_workers_count::double precision
                 / cs.max_workers_count * 100.0
            ELSE 0
        END AS worker_util
    FROM collect.v_cpu_scheduler_stats AS cs
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = cs.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(cs.collection_time)
      AND cs.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY cs.server_id, cs.collection_time DESC
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        CASE
        WHEN l.total_runnable_tasks_count > 50 THEN 'CRITICAL - High runnable task queue'
        WHEN l.total_runnable_tasks_count > 20 THEN 'HIGH - Moderate runnable task queue'
        WHEN l.total_runnable_tasks_count > 10 THEN 'MEDIUM - Some runnable tasks queued'
        WHEN l.worker_util > 90 THEN 'HIGH - Worker thread exhaustion'
        WHEN l.worker_thread_exhaustion_warning THEN 'CRITICAL - Worker thread exhaustion warning'
        WHEN l.runnable_tasks_warning THEN 'HIGH - Runnable tasks warning'
        WHEN l.queued_requests_warning THEN 'MEDIUM - Queued requests warning'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS pressure_level,
        CASE
        WHEN l.total_runnable_tasks_count > 20
        THEN 'CPU pressure detected - check for CPU-intensive queries, consider adding CPU cores'
        WHEN l.worker_thread_exhaustion_warning
        THEN 'Worker thread exhaustion - check max worker threads setting'
        WHEN l.total_queued_request_count > 0
        THEN 'Requests queued for execution - CPU or worker thread pressure'
        ELSE 'No CPU scheduler pressure detected'
    END AS recommendation
    FROM snapshot AS l
)
SELECT
    l.server_label AS "Server",
    m.metric AS "Metric",
    m.value AS "Value",
    CASE WHEN m.warn THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Status"
FROM latest AS l
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (0, 'Pressure Level', l.pressure_level, l.pressure_level NOT LIKE 'NORMAL%'),
    (1, 'Recommendation', l.recommendation, false),
    (2, 'Schedulers', to_char(l.scheduler_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (3, 'Logical CPUs', to_char(l.cpu_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (4, 'NUMA Nodes (online / total)', l.nodes_online_count || ' / ' || l.total_node_count, false),
    (5, 'Offline CPUs', to_char(l.offline_cpu_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), l.offline_cpu_warning),
    (6, 'Max Worker Threads', to_char(l.max_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (7, 'Current Workers', to_char(l.total_current_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), l.worker_thread_exhaustion_warning),
    (8, 'Worker Utilization %', to_char(round((l.worker_util)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0'), l.worker_thread_exhaustion_warning),
    (9, 'Runnable Tasks', to_char(l.total_runnable_tasks_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), l.runnable_tasks_warning),
    (10, 'Avg Runnable / Scheduler', to_char(round((l.avg_runnable_tasks_count)::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00'), l.runnable_tasks_warning),
    (11, 'Work Queue Length', to_char(l.total_work_queue_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (12, 'Active Requests', to_char(l.total_active_request_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (13, 'Queued Requests', to_char(l.total_queued_request_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), l.queued_requests_warning),
    (14, 'Blocked Tasks', to_char(l.total_blocked_task_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), l.blocked_tasks_warning),
    (15, 'Active Parallel Threads', to_char(l.total_active_parallel_thread_count, 'FM999,999,999,990'), false),
    (16, 'Runnable Requests', CASE WHEN l.runnable_request_count IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE to_char(l.runnable_request_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') END, false),
    (17, 'Total Requests', CASE WHEN l.total_request_count IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE to_char(l.total_request_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') END, false),
    (18, 'Runnable %', CASE WHEN l.runnable_percent IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE to_char(round((l.runnable_percent)::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00') END, false),
    (19, 'Total Physical Memory', CASE
            WHEN l.total_physical_memory_kb / 1048576.0 >= 1
            THEN to_char(round((l.total_physical_memory_kb / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || ' GB'
            ELSE to_char(round((l.total_physical_memory_kb / 1024.0)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || ' MB'
        END, false),
    (20, 'Available Physical Memory', CASE
            WHEN l.available_physical_memory_kb / 1048576.0 >= 1
            THEN to_char(round((l.available_physical_memory_kb / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || ' GB'
            ELSE to_char(round((l.available_physical_memory_kb / 1024.0)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || ' MB'
        END, l.physical_memory_pressure_warning),
    (21, 'System Memory State', COALESCE(NULLIF(l.system_memory_state_desc, ''), 'N/A'), l.physical_memory_pressure_warning),
    (22, 'Physical Memory Pressure', CASE WHEN l.physical_memory_pressure_warning THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END, l.physical_memory_pressure_warning)
) AS m(ord, metric, value, warn)
ORDER BY l.server_label, m.ord

panels.title: Memory Summary

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ms.server_id)
    srv.name AS "Server",
    ms.collection_time AS "Collected",
    ms.total_physical_memory_mb AS "Physical Memory",
    ms.total_server_memory_mb AS "SQL Server Memory",
    ms.target_server_memory_mb AS "Target Memory",
    ms.buffer_pool_mb AS "Buffer Pool",
    ms.plan_cache_mb AS "Plan Cache",
    ms.available_physical_memory_mb AS "Available Physical",
    ms.total_page_file_mb AS "Total Page File",
    ms.available_page_file_mb AS "Available Page File",
    ms.system_memory_state AS "System Memory State",
    ms.sql_memory_model AS "Memory Model"
FROM collect.v_memory_stats AS ms
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = ms.server_id
WHERE ms.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY ms.server_id, ms.collection_time DESC

panels.description: Latest collected memory state, independent of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    ms.collection_time AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    s.value / 1024.0 AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_stats AS ms
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('Total Server Memory', ms.total_server_memory_mb),
    ('Target Memory', ms.target_server_memory_mb),
    ('Buffer Pool', ms.buffer_pool_mb)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(ms.collection_time)
  AND ms.server_id IN (${server:csv})
UNION ALL
SELECT
    mg.collection_time AS time,
    'Memory Grants' AS metric,
    SUM(mg.granted_memory_mb) / 1024.0 AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_grant_stats AS mg
WHERE $__timeFilter(mg.collection_time)
  AND mg.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY mg.collection_time
ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (

    SELECT
        mc.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        mc.clerk_type
    FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = mc.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
      AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${clerk_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR mc.clerk_type = ANY(ARRAY[${clerk_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY mc.server_id, srv.name, mc.clerk_type
    ORDER BY SUM(mc.memory_mb) DESC
    LIMIT 5

)
SELECT
    mc.collection_time AS time,
    mc.clerk_type AS metric,
    mc.memory_mb AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON r.server_id = mc.server_id
 AND r.clerk_type = mc.clerk_type
WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
  AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY 1

WITH ranked AS (

    SELECT
        mc.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        mc.clerk_type
    FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = mc.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
      AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${clerk_type:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR mc.clerk_type = ANY(ARRAY[${clerk_type:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY mc.server_id, srv.name, mc.clerk_type
    ORDER BY SUM(mc.memory_mb) DESC
    LIMIT 5

),
latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (mc.server_id, mc.clerk_type)
        r.server_label,
        mc.clerk_type,
        mc.memory_mb
    FROM collect.v_memory_clerks AS mc
    JOIN ranked AS r
      ON r.server_id = mc.server_id
     AND r.clerk_type = mc.clerk_type
    WHERE $__timeFilter(mc.collection_time)
      AND mc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY mc.server_id, mc.clerk_type, mc.collection_time DESC
),
non_bp AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    WHERE clerk_type NOT ILIKE '%BUFFERPOOL%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.server_label)
    n.server_label AS "Server",
    SUM(n.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY n.server_label) AS "Non-BP Total (MB)",
    regexp_replace(n.clerk_type, '^MEMORYCLERK_', '') AS "Top Non-BP Clerk",
    n.memory_mb AS "Top Non-BP Clerk (MB)"
FROM non_bp AS n
ORDER BY n.server_label, n.memory_mb DESC

SELECT
    mg.collection_time AS time,
    'Pool ' || mg.pool_id || ': ' || s.series AS metric,
    SUM(s.value) AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_grant_stats AS mg
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('Available MB', mg.available_memory_mb),
    ('Granted MB', mg.granted_memory_mb),
    ('Used MB', mg.used_memory_mb),
    ('Target MB', mg.target_memory_mb),
    ('Max Target MB', mg.max_target_memory_mb)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(mg.collection_time)
  AND mg.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY mg.collection_time, mg.pool_id, s.series
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    mg.collection_time AS time,
    'Pool ' || mg.pool_id || ': ' || s.series AS metric,
    SUM(s.value) AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_grant_stats AS mg
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('Grantees', mg.grantee_count),
    ('Waiters', mg.waiter_count),
    ('Timeouts', mg.timeout_error_count_delta),
    ('Forced Grants', mg.forced_grant_count_delta)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(mg.collection_time)
  AND mg.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY mg.collection_time, mg.pool_id, s.series
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    pc.collection_time AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    SUM(s.value) AS value
FROM collect.v_plan_cache_stats AS pc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('Single-Use', pc.single_use_size_mb),
    ('Multi-Use', pc.multi_use_size_mb)
) AS s(series, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(pc.collection_time)
  AND pc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY pc.collection_time, s.series
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        pc.server_id,
        srv.name AS server_label,
        MAX(pc.collection_time) AS mx
    FROM collect.v_plan_cache_stats AS pc
    JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = pc.server_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(pc.collection_time)
      AND pc.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY pc.server_id, srv.name
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        l.server_label,
        COALESCE(SUM(pc.total_plans), 0) AS total_plans,
        COALESCE(SUM(pc.single_use_plans), 0) AS single_use_plans,
        MIN(pc.oldest_plan_create_time) AS oldest_plan_create_time
    FROM latest AS l
    JOIN collect.v_plan_cache_stats AS pc
      ON pc.server_id = l.server_id
     AND pc.collection_time = l.mx
    GROUP BY l.server_label
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        CASE
            WHEN t.total_plans > 0
            THEN t.single_use_plans * 100.0 / t.total_plans
            ELSE 0
        END AS single_use_percent
    FROM totals AS t
)
SELECT
    c.server_label AS "Server",
    c.total_plans AS "Total Plans",
    c.oldest_plan_create_time AS "Oldest Plan",
    CASE
        WHEN c.single_use_percent > 50 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN c.single_use_percent > 30 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN c.single_use_percent > 20 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS "Bloat Level",
    CASE
        WHEN c.single_use_percent > 20
        THEN 'Check for unparameterized queries / Consider Forced Parameterization'
        ELSE 'Plan cache composition is healthy'
    END AS "Recommendation"
FROM classified AS c
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    date_trunc('hour', mpe.sample_time) AS time,
    s.series AS metric,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM collect.v_memory_pressure_events AS mpe
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('SQL Server (medium)', mpe.memory_indicators_process = 2),
    ('SQL Server (severe)', mpe.memory_indicators_process >= 3),
    ('Operating System (medium)', mpe.memory_indicators_system = 2),
    ('Operating System (severe)', mpe.memory_indicators_system >= 3)
) AS s(series, hit)
WHERE $__timeFilter(mpe.sample_time)
  AND mpe.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND (mpe.memory_indicators_process >= 2 OR mpe.memory_indicators_system >= 2)
  AND s.hit
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT
        ss.collection_time,
        s.series,
        s.value,
        MAX(s.value) OVER (PARTITION BY s.series) AS series_max
    FROM collect.v_session_summary_stats AS ss
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        ('Total', ss.total_sessions),
        ('Running', ss.running_sessions),
        ('Sleeping', ss.sleeping_sessions),
        ('Background', ss.background_sessions),
        ('Dormant', ss.dormant_sessions),
        ('Idle >30m', ss.idle_sessions_over_30min),
        ('Waiting for Memory', ss.sessions_waiting_for_memory)
    ) AS s(series, value)
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ss.collection_time)
      AND ss.server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    collection_time AS time,
    series AS metric,
    value
FROM expanded
WHERE series_max > 0
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (ss.server_id)
    srv.name AS "Server",
    ss.collection_time AS "Collected",
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ss.top_application_name, '') <> ''
        THEN ss.top_application_name
             || ' (' || COALESCE(ss.top_application_connections, 0) || ')'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "Top Application",
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ss.top_host_name, '') <> ''
        THEN ss.top_host_name || ' (' || COALESCE(ss.top_host_connections, 0) || ')'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "Top Host",
    ss.databases_with_connections AS "Databases"
FROM collect.v_session_summary_stats AS ss
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = ss.server_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ss.collection_time)
  AND ss.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY ss.server_id, ss.collection_time DESC

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT pm.server_id, pm.counter_name
    FROM collect.v_perfmon_stats AS pm
    WHERE $__timeFilter(pm.collection_time)
      AND pm.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND (${pack:sqlstring} = 'All Counters'
       OR pm.counter_name IN (
              SELECT p.counter
              FROM (VALUES
    ('General Throughput', 'Batch Requests/sec'),
    ('General Throughput', 'SQL Compilations/sec'),
    ('General Throughput', 'SQL Re-Compilations/sec'),
    ('General Throughput', 'Query optimizations/sec'),
    ('General Throughput', 'Network IO waits'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Memory Grants Pending'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Granted Workspace Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Target Server Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Total Server Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Stolen Server Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Lock Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'SQL Cache Memory (KB)'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Lazy writes/sec'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Free list stalls/sec'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Reduced memory grants/sec'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Memory grant queue waits'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Thread-safe memory objects waits'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Page reads/sec'),
    ('Memory Pressure', 'Readahead pages/sec'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Batch Requests/sec'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'SQL Compilations/sec'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'SQL Re-Compilations/sec'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Query optimizations/sec'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Active parallel threads'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Active requests'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Queued requests'),
    ('CPU / Compilation', 'Wait for the worker'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Page reads/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Page writes/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Checkpoint pages/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Page lookups/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Readahead pages/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Background writer pages/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Log Flushes/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Log Bytes Flushed/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Log Flush Write Time (ms)'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Page IO latch waits'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Log buffer waits'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Log write waits'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Full Scans/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Index Searches/sec'),
    ('I/O Pressure', 'Page Splits/sec'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Version Store Size (KB)'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Free Space in tempdb (KB)'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Active Temp Tables'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Version Generation rate (KB/s)'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Version Cleanup rate (KB/s)'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Temp Tables Creation Rate'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Workfiles Created/sec'),
    ('TempDB Pressure', 'Worktables Created/sec'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Lock Requests/sec'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Lock Wait Time (ms)'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Lock Waits/sec'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Number of Deadlocks/sec'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Table Lock Escalations/sec'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Blocked tasks'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Lock waits'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Non-Page latch waits'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Page latch waits'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Processes blocked'),
    ('Lock / Blocking', 'Lock Timeouts/sec')
              ) AS p(pack, counter)
              WHERE p.pack = ${pack:sqlstring}
          ))
      AND (cardinality(ARRAY[${counter:sqlstring}]::text[]) = 0 OR pm.counter_name = ANY(ARRAY[${counter:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY pm.server_id, pm.counter_name
    ORDER BY SUM(pm.delta_cntr_value) DESC
    LIMIT 12
)
SELECT
    pm.collection_time AS time,
    pm.counter_name AS metric,
    SUM(pm.delta_cntr_value) AS value
FROM collect.v_perfmon_stats AS pm
JOIN ranked AS r
  ON r.server_id = pm.server_id
 AND r.counter_name = pm.counter_name
WHERE $__timeFilter(pm.collection_time)
  AND pm.server_id IN (${server:csv})
GROUP BY pm.collection_time, pm.counter_name
ORDER BY 1
